about: Per-player appearance for the 25 added moments' team-seasons, row for row with <team>.csv. tone = 2K5 skin tone 0 (lightest) .. 5 (darkest), the low three bits of the record's skin; null keeps the template record. retail = the player's own retail 2004 record (same name and birth date): its photo id, whole skin value, face and dreads. Sources: retail_2004 (the game's own record for him), *_reviewed (that tone corrected after a look at his official photo), headshot_2026 (the 2026 roster's measured tone), headshot_review (his official NFL/ESPN headshot, reviewed by eye against reference tones), photo_review (another photo of him), retail_historic_same_season (the retail historic record with his jersey and position in that season), public_record (well-known player with no usable photo), none. Compiled 2026-10-02 (beta 76.3).
